program.name: Restaurant Meals Program route
program.description: Checks whether a current CalFresh household may fit a qualifying RMP category.

versions.source_label: California Department of Social Services Restaurant Meals Program
versions.notice: Routing feature only. It does not approve CalFresh or guarantee that a restaurant participates.

conditions.fail_reason: This route generally requires current CalFresh participation.
conditions.unknown_reason: Current CalFresh participation is needed for this route.

conditions.pass_reason: Age 60 or older may fit an RMP category.
A disability-related category may fit the route.
conditions.fail_reason: A disability category was not reported.
conditions.unknown_reason: Disability information could change this route.

conditions.pass_reason: The reported housing situation may fit the homelessness category.
conditions.fail_reason: A qualifying housing situation was not indicated.
conditions.unknown_reason: Housing status could change this route.
conditions.expected_text: Temporary, sheltered, unsheltered, or no fixed address

next_steps.MAY_QUALIFY: Check the current RMP participant route and participating restaurant list.
next_steps.NEEDS_INFORMATION: Answer only the missing questions you are comfortable with or ask a benefits worker.
next_steps.LIKELY_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Use direct food resources and ordinary CalFresh retailer options.
next_steps.RULE_UNDER_REVIEW: Use the current CDSS RMP source.

result_summaries.DIRECT_RESOURCE: Available to everyone without completing the eligibility survey.
result_summaries.LIKELY_ELIGIBLE: Your current answers meet every rule included in this pre-screen. The official agency still decides.
result_summaries.MAY_QUALIFY: Your current answers make this a useful next step, but the provider or agency must confirm remaining requirements.
result_summaries.NEEDS_INFORMATION: A small number of unanswered items could change this result.
result_summaries.LIKELY_NOT_ELIGIBLE: At least one current answer does not meet this pre-screen. Open the details to compare what was expected with what you entered.
result_summaries.RULE_UNDER_REVIEW: SANDI will not rely on this rule until its owner reviews the current version.
